name: All visible reference URLs use HTTPS
description: Reference source URLs in the analysis panel should use secure HTTPS links, not plain HTTP. Mixed content or insecure links are not acceptable on a modern web application.

planSteps.description: Click on a bracket cell to open a match detail page
Scroll to the References section and inspect the visible URLs
Verify that all visible reference URLs in the References section start with https:// rather than http://. If any URL starts with plain http://, the test fails.
